column1: # Shrink-only record of the platform/SaaS spine rules that are NOT fully enforced
# (#874). Every row is a rule whose control-coverage status is PARTIAL or GAP.
# Recording is an EXPLICIT REVIEWED ACT and is never automatic: a NEW gap is
# refused by name by scripts/check-control-coverage.sh. Closing a gap is always
# welcome — flip the rule's status in scripts/control-coverage.tsv to ENFORCED,
# then re-run with --record, which SHRINKS this list and refuses to raise it.
